scope: Exact four supplied theorem records for the complete dual-cone reciprocal-norm count and supporting inner-modulus estimates for Lemma 5.3. Extracted package evidence, not a fresh execution report.

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      ¬IsSquare A.det →
        ∀ (ε : ℝ),
          0 < ε →
            ∃ C,
              0 < C ∧
                ∀ (U : ℝ),
                  1 ≤ U →
                    ∑ u ∈ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.dualConeFrequencies A U,
                        (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u)⁻¹ ≤
                      C * U ^ (1 + ε)
checked_exports.scope: The bound in equation conecount for the adjugate of the source matrix. The constant depends only on the integral form and the positive exponent.

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (q d : ℕ) (u : Fin 4 → ℤ)
  (f : ℝ → ℂ) {X η K L : ℝ},
  1 ≤ X →
    0 < η →
      0 ≤ K →
        0 ≤ L →
          f X = 0 →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 1 X, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t) →
              (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 1 X, ‖deriv f t‖ ≤ L / t ^ 4) →
                (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 1 X, ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.unweightedModulusSum q d A u t‖ ≤ K * t ^ (3 + η)) →
                  ‖∑ k ∈ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.gcdModuliUpTo q d ⌊X⌋₊,
                        f ↑k * QuaternaryQuadraticForms.unweightedCompleteSumValue k A u‖ ≤
                    L * K * X ^ η / η
checked_exports.scope: Abel summation up to the common support endpoint. Cancellation in the unweighted complete sums is taken before the absolute value.

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ (I : ℝ → ℂ) {t Q L : ℝ},
  0 < t →
    0 < Q →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ I (t / Q) →
        ‖I (t / Q)‖ + t / Q * ‖deriv I (t / Q)‖ ≤ L * t →
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.coneIntegralWeight I Q) t ∧
            ‖deriv (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.coneIntegralWeight I Q) t‖ ≤ 4 * L / t ^ 4
checked_exports.scope: The derivative bound for the partial-summation weight follows at the real scale t/Q. Its complex delta integral is differentiated at fixed v.

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ {A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ},
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      ¬IsSquare A.det →
        ∀ {weights : Set (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.RealVector4 → ℂ)}
          {σ : (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.RealVector4 → ℂ) → ℂ} {r₀ η : ℝ},
          1 ≤ r₀ →
            0 < η →
              η ≤ 1 / 4 →
                QuaternaryQuadraticForms.DeltaIntegralBounds
                    (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.realQuadraticValue (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom ℝ))) σ weights (Set.Ioi 0) →
                  (∀ w ∈ weights,
                      ∀ (v : QuaternaryQuadraticForms.RealVector4),
                        QuaternaryQuadraticForms.deltaIntegral
                            (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.realQuadraticValue (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom ℝ))) w r₀ v =
                          0) →
                    ∃ C,
                      0 < C ∧
                        ∀ w ∈ weights,
                          ∀ (q d e : ℕ) [NeZero q] [NeZero d] [NeZero e],
                            Squarefree q →
                              q = d * e →
                                q.Coprime (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A) →
                                  ∀ (B : ℝ),
                                    1 ≤ B →
                                      1 ≤ B / √↑q →
                                        ∀ (u : Fin 4 → ℤ),
                                          u ⬝ᵥ A.adjugate.mulVec u = 0 →
                                            0 < QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u →
                                              QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u ≤ √↑q * B ^ η →
                                                have Q := B / √↑q;
                                                have I := fun r =>
                                                  QuaternaryQuadraticForms.deltaIntegral
                                                    (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.realQuadraticValue
                                                      (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom ℝ)))
                                                    w r ((√↑q)⁻¹ • QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerRealVector u);
                                                ‖∑ c ∈ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.gcdModuliUpTo q d ⌊r₀ * Q⌋₊,
                                                      QuaternaryQuadraticForms.coneIntegralWeight I Q ↑c *
                                                        QuaternaryQuadraticForms.unweightedCompleteSumValue c A u‖ ≤
                                                  C * (↑q / (B * QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u)) *
                                                      B ^ (3 * η) *
                                                    (B * ↑q) ^ η
checked_exports.scope: The inner modulus sum of Lemma 5.3, for each individual gcd class and nonzero dual-cone frequency. The constant is uniform in all arithmetic data.
